spans.s: kaḍḍhaka (IE 8-8; EI 30), probably the same as Sanskrit karṣaka; see ḍheṅku-kaḍḍhaka.
Kaḍit-āmātya (EI 23), Kannaḍa-Sanskrit; official designation; same as Kaḍita-věrgaḍě (q. v.).

Kaḍita-věrgaḍě (IE 8-3), Kannaḍa; superintendent of accounts and records; same as Akṣapaṭalika; sometimes also called Mahāpradhāna, Hěrisandhivigrahin, Senādhipati, etc., additionally. See Kaḍit-āmātya.
Kaḍīya (LP), a bricklayer or mason; cf. Gujarātī Kaḍīyā.
kaḍamai (SITI), Tamil; revenue, tax to be paid to the government in kind.
kāḍu-kāval (SITI), Tamil; tax for the preservation and maintenance of forests.
